# Mark A. Conway-Greenslade

> Technology leader and software engineer/architect with 20+ years delivering complex systems across both the private and public sectors in domains such as climatology, quantum instrumentation, cryptography, blockchain, finance & telecoms. Member of the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) and the Central Bank Research Association. Based in Zug, Switzerland.

This site is a single-page CV available in English, French, German and Chinese. Append `?lang=en|fr|de|zh` to select a language. Machine-readable profile data is embedded in the page as JSON-LD (schema.org ProfilePage).
